color.worst_reason: Accent coral CTA and gradient card fills match closely, though some gradients (Signal Drift, Cold Open) appear slightly more diffuse/pink rather than the reference's sharper diagonal striped texture.

typography.worst_reason: Heading sizes, caps labels, and pill text largely match, though the blockquote uses an italic serif in the agent version versus a non-italic style in the reference.

assets.worst_reason: Reference shows distinct themed icons (palette, document, etc.) and merch product illustrations, while the generated version uses generic placeholder square icons and question-mark placeholders on merch cards.

proportion.worst_reason: Button padding, pill sizing, and spacing are very close, with only minor differences in the audio player control sizing and header layout density.

states.worst_reason: Interactive states like the filled coral CTA button and play button appear consistent with the reference.

episode.explanation: The score is held back primarily by extensive textual content mismatches across nearly every section (breadcrumb, chapters, links mentioned, share/subscribe, and footer all score 0.00, with nav, player details, and quote also very low), and secondarily by the blockquote being rendered in an italic serif rather than the reference's non-italic style.

episodes.explanation: The score is held back primarily by missing or mismatched navigation, search filter, and pagination content (all scoring 0.00 in word-set F1), along with an incomplete footer (0.29) that fails to replicate the reference's text and links.

home.explanation: The score is held down by missing or mismatched textual content in key sections (nav, newsletter_signup, and about_network all scored 0.00) and weak content fidelity in the shows_grid (0.19) and editors_pick (0.31) sections despite strong visual styling.

shows.explanation: The score is held back primarily by missing or mismatched navigation and footer content (nav F1 0.31, footer and filter_bar F1 0.00), compounded by proportion issues where cards render slightly tighter and the Field Recordings card places its title at the top unlike the reference.

support.explanation: The score is held back primarily by missing or mismatched textual content across nearly every section (nav, hero, donation form, and footer all scoring near 0 F1) and by weak asset fidelity, where themed icons and merch product illustrations are replaced with generic placeholder squares and question marks.
